newsitem.title: UK: Moody's assigns Dresdner Luxembourg ratings.
newsitem.headline: Moody's assigns Dresdner Luxembourg ratings.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Friday it assigned to Dresdner Bank Luxembourg S.A. a rating of Aa1 for long-term deposits and a Prime-1 rating for short-term deposits.
The rating agency said in a statement it also assigned a counterparty rating of Aa1 and a bank financial strength rating of B to the bank.
"The ratings are based on the bank's own good fundamentals as well as the public statement of support...from its 100 percent parent, Dresdner Bank AG (rated Aaa/Prime-1).

"Dresdner Bank Luxembourg is primarily involved in international corporate banking and private banking. It provides services to its subsidiary Dresdner Bank (Ireland ) Plc, its own customer base and many of the parent company's international customers," Moody's said.
It has support functions for other Dresdner Bank subsidiaries and provides data processing services for Dresdner Bank's Luxembourg branch and some other group subsidiaries.

"For these reasons Moody's considers the Luxembourg bank's franchise to be inextricably linked to that of its parent. Risks for the bank include the inherent uncertainties related to Luxembourg's competitive position as a financial center as well as the future development of Dresdner Bank AG's franchise in more competitive home and global markets," it said.
